_comment: Local site settings for the comic download stage -- copy this file to
src/comic_site.json and fill in the real site.
This example is tracked; comic_site.json is gitignored, exactly like
scraper_config.json. Keep it that way: the tracked half of the comic's
settings (comic_config.json) must never name a real site.
TWO SHAPES ARE ACCEPTED. The flat one is the original and still works with
no edit; the 'sites' map is for more than one site, which is what --site
selects between.
FLAT (one site):
'comic_series_url'  the series page for a slug, with {slug} filled in
from --slug (or --name).
'comic_site_host'   the only host page images may come from, including
its subdomains.
MAP (several sites):
'sites'             {name: {comic_series_url, comic_site_host, ...}}
'default_site'      which name to use when --site is omitted. Required
only when more than one site is listed.
THE SHAPE KEYS ARE OVERRIDES. Leave them out and the Madara/MangaStream
WordPress theme is assumed, which is what this project was built against.
Only set the ones a site actually differs on:
chapter_list_url       default '{series_url}ajax/chapters/'
{series_url} carries a trailing slash; {slug} is
also available.
chapter_list_method    default 'POST'. Madara answers with this; a plain
GET returns '0', which is why it is not a GET.
chapter_list_headers   default {'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'}
chapter_link_selector  default 'a[href*=chapter]'
image_selector         default 'img.wp-manga-chapter-img'
image_attribute        default 'data-src'. Set to 'src' for a site that
does not lazy-load; the default is what stops a
loading spinner being saved as page 1.
The placeholder below (comic-site.test) is a reserved test suffix and is
not a real site. The downloader refuses to run until it is filled in.
Do not use example.com here: the host check accepts subdomains of the
configured host, so it would also accept evil.example.com.
